interaction: Design a set on a porcelain SVG hand: pick a nail (or all five), then a colour (12 swatches or a custom picker), finish (gloss, matte, chrome, cat-eye shimmer that follows the pointer) and art (French tip, dots, stripes, stars) with a polish-stroke repaint; switch almond / square / coffin shapes and 'Save my set' to create design cards that can prefill a booking request.
notes: Saved sets are kept only in this browser (up to six). The booking request ends in a demo toast; time slots marked 'taken' are illustrative. Prices are samples.
